protocol.a_min: actual minimum of each observed coefficient field, not nominal contrast metadata
protocol.bound: sqrt(diag(B^-1) * d.T @ B^-1 @ d) / a_min; B=A(1), d=r-Az
protocol.ci_scope: conditional on frozen trained networks and the declared sampled-field distribution
protocol.corrected_prediction: u_hat - z; its relative L2 error uses ||u_true|| in the denominator
protocol.correction: zero-start Poisson-preconditioned CG at fixed iteration budgets
protocol.numeric_scope: exact-arithmetic discrete inequality evaluated in float64; no formal floating-point enclosure
protocol.numeric_tolerance_use: evaluation only; never added to analytic bounds or used to create flags
protocol.rank_ties: strict separation leaves ambiguous ties unresolved; truth top set selects ceil(q*n) cells
protocol.resampling_unit: whole sampled coefficient fields; repeated checkerboards are repeated draws from a finite catalogue
protocol.source_of_bound: classical energy Cauchy-Schwarz and inverse Loewner ordering; no novel theorem claimed
protocol.truth_usage: reference errors enter only evaluation, after enclosures and rank flags are formed
